title: Repair quotation
modifyPh: Lower labor, drop the roof sheets…
acceptedHint: Accepted. A construction order is ready — open Orders to follow the job.
pageDesc: Accept to lock the scope. You then pay a 15% deposit. BuildMate holds it until the job is validly completed.
acceptBody: Accepting creates a repair order and a 15% deposit. BuildMate holds the money (mock). The 5% platform fee is 5% of the quote total. You pay the remaining 85% directly to the contractor. Cancelling after the deposit may forfeit it under the accepted terms, except where the contractor is at fault.
terms: I have read and agree to the deposit, cancellation, and 5% platform-fee terms.
laborHint: Add free-form labor lines or pick from your registered services. Line total = quantity × unit price.
mrlReadyBody: Store {store} already quoted. You can apply those prices to materials and transport.
mrlOverwriteConfirm: Current material lines will be replaced by the store quote. Continue?
totalMin: Quotation total must be greater than zero.
